blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video captioning aims to preserve visual information through compact descriptions, predominantly using natural language. However, precisely expressing fine-grained spatial structures and temporal dynamics in natural language often leads to lengthy and potentially ambiguous descriptions. In this work, we explore Code as Video Caption, a paradigm where executable programs serve as a complementary representation of visual content through graphical primitives, layout rules, and functions of time. To examine whether code captions effectively preserve video information, we compare them with natural language captions on downstream question answering and video reconstruction tasks. Our results show that code captions achieve superior reasoning accuracy and reconstruction fidelity. Despite these advantages, realizing the potential of code captioning depends on whether current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate faithful code captions. To systematically assess this capability, we introduce CodeCap-Bench, which comprises 323 videos spanning five categories of structured 2D content, along with fine-grained annotations and a multi-level evaluation framework. Extensive experiments reveal that while leading proprietary MLLMs demonstrate promising code captioning capabilities, they still struggle to faithfully capture complex temporal dynamics, with open-source models lagging substantially behind.
blocks.zh: 视频字幕旨在通过紧凑的描述来保存视觉信息,主要使用自然语言. 然而,在自然语言中精确地表达精细的空间结构和时间动态往往导致冗长而可能模糊的描述. 在这部作品中,我们探索代码作为Video Caption,一种范式,可执行程序通过图形原始,布局规则,以及时间的功能来作为视觉内容的补充表现. 为了检查代码标题是否有效保存了视频信息,我们把它们与下游问答和视频重建任务的自然语言标题进行比较. 我们的结果显示,代码标题 实现更高的推理精度 和重建忠诚。 尽管有这些优点,实现代码标题的潜力取决于目前的多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)能否产生忠实的代码标题. 为了系统地评估这一能力,我们引入了CodeCap-Bench,它包括323个视频,涵盖五类结构化的2D内容,以及精细的说明和多层次的评价框架。 广泛的实验显示,虽然领先的专有MLLMs展现出有希望的代码字幕能力,但它们仍然难以忠实地捕捉到复杂的时间动态,开源模型严重落后.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video captioning [ Chen et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026c ; Chen et al., 2026d ; Chen et al., 2026e ; Li et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026e ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026c ] aims to preserve visual information in videos through compact descriptions.
Existing methods mainly rely on natural language to describe objects, attributes, actions, and events [ Chu et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Xue et al., 2025 ] .
However, videos also contain fine-grained spatial structures and temporal dynamics, including complex layouts, motion trajectories, and coordinated changes among multiple objects.
Precisely expressing this information in natural language often requires many positional, temporal, and relational constraints, making descriptions lengthy and potentially ambiguous.
This motivates us to explore Code as Video Caption , where executable programs provide a complementary way to represent visual content through graphical primitives, layout rules, and temporal logic [ Chen et al., 2025c ; Rodriguez et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ] .
blocks.zh:
视频字幕[Chen等人,2026b;Chen等人,2026c;Chen等人,2026d;Chen等人,2026e;Li等人,2026;Liu等人,2026;Shi等人,2025;Wang等人,2026b;Wang等人,2026e;Wu等人,2025;Xu等人,2026c]旨在通过紧凑描述在视频中保存视觉信息.
现有方法主要依靠自然语言来描述物体,属性,行动和事件[Chu等人,2025年;Ma等人,2026年;薛等人,2025年].
然而,视频也包含精细的空间结构和时间动态,包括复杂的布局,运动轨迹,以及多个物体间的协调变化.
以自然语言准确表达这种信息往往需要许多立场、时间和关系方面的限制,使描述冗长,可能模糊不清。
这激励了我们探索代码作为视频字幕(Video Caption),其中可执行程序提供了通过图形原始,布局规则,以及时间逻辑来代表视觉内容的补充方式[Chen等人,2025c;Rodriguez等人,2025;Zhang等人,2026].

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 1 , executable code has three complementary advantages compared with natural language descriptions in representing video information. First, code captures rule-based spatial structure. In the flight seat-selection interface, grid rules specify seat positions and spacing, while a shared drawing function defines seat geometry, compactly representing repeated elements and their spatial relationships. Second, code supports computable temporal evolution. While the natural language caption states that “the seat map scrolls downward,” time functions specify the scrolling interval, displacement, and easing, allowing the scroll position to be computed at any intermediate time. Finally, code provides an executable visual specification. Conditional logic specifies which seat changes color and when a selection mark appears, and executing these rules produces the corresponding visual states. Together, these properties make spatial layouts, motion, and state changes explicit, reduce ambiguity in how visual details are interpreted, and allow the rendered video to be directly compared with the reference video.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,可执行代码在代表视频信息方面与自然语言描述相比有三个互补优势. 首先,代码捕捉基于规则的空间结构. 在飞行座椅选择界面中,网格规则指定座位位置和间隔,而共享绘图函数则定义座位几何,紧凑地代表了重复元素及其空间关系. 第二,代码支持可计算的时间演化. 虽然自然语言标题指出“座椅图向下滚动”,但时间函数指定了滚动间隔、移位和放松,从而可以在任何中间时间计算滚动位置。 最后,代码提供了可执行的视觉规格. 有条件的逻辑指定了哪个座位会改变颜色以及何时出现选择标记,执行这些规则会产生相应的视觉状态. 这些属性加在一起,使空间布局,运动,状态变化变得明确,减少视觉细节如何解释的模糊性,并允许将渲染的视频直接与参考视频进行比较.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Illustration of video captioning with executable code. The reference video shows a flight seat-selection interface. (a) and (b) present natural language and code captions of the same segment, respectively. The code caption encodes spatial structure, temporal dynamics, and visual state changes through executable rules and functions.
blocks.zh: 图1:带有可执行代码的视频字幕说明。 参考视频显示飞行座位选择界面. (a)和(b)分别介绍同一部分的自然语言和代码标题。 代码标题通过可执行规则和功能编码空间结构,时间动态和视觉状态变化.

blocks.en: To examine the practical value of code as video caption, we compare code and natural language captions through question answering and video reconstruction (Section 4.3.6 ). Under the evaluated settings, videos rendered from code captions support more accurate question answering and better preserve the appearance, motion patterns, and spatial structure of the original videos in reconstruction, providing evidence of the potential of code captions to preserve and utilize video information.
blocks.zh: 为了审查代码作为视频字幕的实际价值,我们通过问答和视频重建来比较代码和自然语言字幕(第4.3.6节)。 在评价的设置下,通过代码标题提供的视频支持更准确的回答问题,更好地保存重建中原始视频的外观、运动模式和空间结构,并提供了代码标题保存和利用视频信息的潜力的证据。

blocks.en: Despite this promise, a dedicated benchmark for this task is still lacking, and the ability of current multimodal large language models [ Anthropic, 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; OpenAI, 2026b ; Qwen Team, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026d ; Z.ai, 2026 ] to generate faithful code captions has yet to be systematically evaluated. In particular, how accurately models can represent spatial layouts, motion trajectories, and state changes, and how these capabilities vary across content types and generation settings, remain open questions.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这一承诺,但这一任务的专用基准仍然缺乏,目前多式联运大语言模型[Anthropic, 2026;Chen等人, 2026a;OpenAI, 2026b;Quen Team, 2026;Wang等人, 2026c;Wang等人, 2026d;Z.ai, 2026] 生成忠实代码标题的能力尚未得到系统评价. 特别是,模型如何准确反映空间布局,运动轨迹,以及状态变化,这些能力如何因内容类型和生成设置而异,仍然是有待解决的问题.

blocks.en:
To address these questions, we introduce CodeCap-Bench , a benchmark for systematically evaluating the code captioning capabilities of MLLMs.
We focus on structured 2D videos whose visual content can be represented programmatically.
CodeCap-Bench comprises 323 323 videos across five categories: desktop and application interfaces, 2D games, visual design and media animation, data and scientific visualization, and icons and abstract motion graphics.
We provide fine-grained focal-point annotations of key static and dynamic content, together with object-level spatio-temporal annotations.
By rendering generated code into videos, we evaluate caption fidelity along three complementary dimensions: visual similarity , object-level spatio-temporal IoU , and fine-grained visual information retention .
This framework enables systematic assessment of how faithfully models preserve visual appearance, spatial structure, and temporal dynamics through executable code.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这些问题,我们采用了CodeCap-Bench,这是系统评价MLLMs代码标题能力的基准。
我们专注于结构化的2D视频,其视觉内容可以以节目形式呈现.
CodeCap-Bench包含323,323个视频,分为五类:桌面和应用界面,2D游戏,视觉设计和媒体动画,数据和科学可视化,以及图标和抽象运动图形.
我们对关键静态和动态内容提供精细的焦点说明,以及对象级的时空说明。
通过将生成的代码渲染成视频,我们按照三个互补维度来评价标题的忠实性:视觉相似性、对象水平的时空IoU以及精细的视觉信息保存。
这一框架有助于系统地评估模型如何通过可执行代码来维护视觉外观、空间结构和时间动态。

blocks.en:
We conduct extensive experiments to investigate the ability of current MLLMs to generate code captions.
Our evaluation reveals substantial differences across models, with dynamic visual information consistently less faithfully preserved than static content.
We further examine the effects of agentic workflows, thinking effort, and generation cost on caption fidelity and reliability.
These results reveal the capabilities and limitations of current models in generating faithful code captions and provide empirical evidence to help connect video understanding with programmatic generation.
blocks.zh:
我们进行了广泛的实验,以调查当前MLLMs生成代码标题的能力.
我们的评价显示,各模型之间存在巨大差异,动态的视觉信息一直不如静态内容完整。
我们进一步审查代理工作流程、思维努力和生成成本对标题诚实性和可靠性的影响。
这些结果揭示了当前模型在生成忠实的代码标题方面的能力和局限性,并提供经验证据,帮助将视频理解与程序生成联系起来.

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We explore Code as Video Caption , investigating executable code as a complementary representation for preserving fine-grained visual information, spatial structure, and temporal dynamics. Code captions have an explicit visual interpretation that can be checked through rendering, with question-answering and video reconstruction comparisons providing further empirical support for their value. • We introduce CodeCap-Bench , a benchmark comprising 323 323 videos across five categories of structured 2D content, with fine-grained focal-point and object-level spatio-temporal annotations. We establish a multi-level evaluation framework covering global visual similarity, object-level spatio-temporal alignment, and fine-grained visual information retention. • We systematically evaluate MLLMs across generation settings, finding that leading proprietary models show promise but struggle with complex temporal dynamics, while open-source models lag substantially behind. We also analyze the relationships among caption fidelity, generation reliability, and cost.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献可归纳如下: 我们探索代码作为视频字幕, 代码标题有明确的视觉解释,可以通过渲染检查,问答和视频重建比较为这些解释的价值提供进一步的经验支持。 我们引入了CodeCap-Bench, 这个由323,323个视频构成的基准, 包含五类结构化的2D内容, 我们建立了一个多层次的评价框架,涵盖全球视觉相似性、物体层面的时空对齐以及精细的视觉信息保留。 我们系统地评估不同代的 MLLMs , 发现领先的专有模型显示有希望,但与复杂的时间动态发生斗争,而开源模型则大大落后。 我们还分析了标题忠贞、生成可靠性和成本之间的关系。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Recent video captioning studies increasingly focus on fine-grained visual information beyond high-level semantic summaries.
DREAM-1K [ Wang et al., 2024 ] provides detailed descriptions of events, actions, and motion, VDC [ Chai et al., 2025 ] structures captions around objects, backgrounds, and camera motion, and CaReBench [ Xu et al., 2026b ] distinguishes spatial and temporal information for captioning and retrieval.
Caption evaluation has also shifted toward assessing preserved visual information rather than text similarity alone.
VDCscore [ Chai et al., 2025 ] and VidCapBench [ Chen et al., 2025b ] use reference-caption-derived question-answer pairs and targeted video-attribute questions, respectively, while CapQuiz [ Wang et al., 2026f ] adopts reference-free multiple-choice questions.
Whereas these methods evaluate natural language captions, CodeCap-Bench evaluates executable code captions through rendered videos, measuring overall visual similarity, object-level spatio-temporal IoU, and fine-grained visual information retention.
blocks.zh:
近期的视频字幕研究越来越注重高层次语义摘要之外的精细视觉信息.
DREAM-1K [Wang等人,2024年]详细描述了事件,行动和运动,VDC [Chai等人,2025年]围绕物体,背景,和相机运动的结构标题,Care Bench [Xu等人,2026b]区分了用于标题和检索的时空信息.
说明评价也转向评估保存的视觉信息,而不仅仅是文本的相似性。
VDCscore [Chai等人,2025年]和VidCap Bench [Chen等人,2025年b]分别使用参考标题衍生的问答对和有针对性的视频属性问题,而CapQuiz [Wang等人,2026f]则采用免参考的多选择问题.
这些方法评价自然语言标题,而CodeCap-Bench则通过渲染的视频评价可执行的代码标题,衡量整体视觉相似性,对象水平的spatio-时空IoU,以及精细的视觉信息保留.

blocks.en:
Recent studies explore reconstructing visual content through executable code.
For static images, Design2Code [ Si et al., 2025 ] , ChartMimic [ Yang et al., 2025 ] , and Image2Struct [ Roberts et al., 2024 ] evaluate code generation from webpage screenshots, scientific charts, and images of structured content, respectively.
Other studies examine how code preserves visual information.
VCode [ Lin et al., 2025 ] evaluates semantic information retained in SVG representations through CodeVQA, while CodePercept [ Guan et al., 2026 ] improves STEM image perception through code-grounded training and assesses visual understanding through reconstruction code generation.
For videos, Animation2Code [ Ji et al., 2026 ] evaluates web animation reconstruction using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript through appearance and temporal metrics.
BVB [ Tang et al., 2026 ] reconstructs indoor videos as animated Blender scenes, evaluated through spatio-temporal questions and representation similarity.
Related studies reconstruct interactive webpages from user interaction videos, assessing appearance, interaction states, and functionality [ Chen et al., 2026f ; Dai et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026a ] .
While these studies focus on specific domains, CodeCap-Bench evaluates code-based video captioning across diverse structured 2D videos, emphasizing fine-grained visual information retention and spatio-temporal fidelity.
blocks.zh:
最近的研究探索通过可执行代码重建视觉内容.
对于静态图像,Design2Code [Si等人,2025],ChartMimic [Yang等人,2025],以及Image2Struct [Roberts等人,2024]分别通过网页截图,科学图表,结构化内容的图像来评价代码生成.
其他研究考察代码如何保存视觉信息.
VCode [Lin et al., 2025]通过 CodeVQA评价SVG表达中保留的语义信息,而CodePercept [Guan et al., 2026]通过基于代码的培训改进了STEM图像感知,并通过重建代码生成来评估视觉理解.
对于视频,Animation2Code[Ji等人,2026年]通过外观和时间度量评价使用HTML,CSS和JavaScript进行网络动画重建.
BVB [Tang et al., 2026] 将室内视频重建为动画Blender场景,通过Spatio-时空问题和表现相似来评价.
相关研究从用户互动视频重建互动网页,评估外观,互动状态,以及功能[. Chen等人,2026f;Dai等人,2026;徐等人,2026a)].
虽然这些研究侧重于特定领域,但CodeCap-Bench评价了不同结构的2D视频的基于代码的视频字幕,强调精细的视觉信息保留和时空忠诚.

blocks.en: 3 CodeCap-Bench
blocks.zh: 3 密码卡- Bench

blocks.en: 3.1 Task Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 制定任务

blocks.en:
We formulate video captioning with code as the task of expressing visual content and its temporal evolution through executable programs.
Given a reference video V = { I t } t ∈ [ 0 , T ] V=\{I_{t}\}_{t\in[0,T]} of duration T T , the goal is to generate a code caption C C that captures its visual elements, spatial layouts, and temporal dynamics.
Unlike natural language captions, which describe visual content through text, code captions explicitly specify how visual elements are constructed, arranged, and updated over time using graphical primitives, layout rules, and temporal logic.
We focus on the pure-code setting, where all visual content must be generated programmatically without reusing reference frames or external visual assets.
Executing the code through a rendering engine ℛ \mathcal{R} produces a video V ^ = ℛ ⁡ ( C ) \hat{V}=\mathcal{R}(C) , whose visual states should align with those of the reference video throughout the timeline.
Code caption fidelity is therefore evaluated by comparing V ^ \hat{V} with V V in terms of visual appearance, spatial structure, and temporal dynamics.
blocks.zh:
我们用代码制作视频字幕,作为通过可执行程序表达视觉内容及其时间演化的任务.
参考视频 V={ i t } t → [0, T] V=\{I_{t}\}_{t\\ in [0, T] 持续时间 T T ,目标是生成一个代码标题 C ,捕捉其视觉元素,空间布局,以及时间动态.
与通过文本描述视觉内容的自然语言标题不同的是,代码标题明确规定了视觉元素的构造,排列,并随着时间的推移使用图形原始,布局规则,以及时间逻辑进行更新.
我们侧重于纯码设置,其中所有视觉内容都必须在程序上生成,而不重复使用参考框架或外部视觉资产。
通过渲染引擎R\ mathcal{R}执行代码产生视频 V^ = R → (C)\hat{V}=\mathcal{R}(C),其视觉状态应该与参考视频在全时段一致.
因此,通过在视觉外观、空间结构和时间动态方面将V ^\hat{V}和 V V 作比较来评价代码的忠实性。

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation Framework
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价框架

blocks.en:
We evaluate code caption fidelity along three complementary dimensions: visual similarity , object-level spatio-temporal IoU , and fine-grained visual information retention .
These metrics assess the consistency between the reference and rendered videos at different levels.
Visual similarity measures global similarity in visual content, appearance, and motion patterns, while spatio-temporal IoU evaluates the spatial and temporal alignment of key objects.
Fine-grained visual information retention further examines how well important static content and dynamic processes are preserved.
blocks.zh:
我们按照三个互补维度来评价代码标题的忠贞性:视觉相似性、物体层面的时空IoU和精细的视觉信息保留。
这些衡量标准评估了不同级别参考和制作的视频的一致性。
视觉相似度测量视觉内容,外观,运动规律方面的全球相似度,而spatio-timperal IoU则评价关键物体的时空对齐.
精细的视觉信息保留进一步审查了如何保存静态内容和动态过程。

blocks.en: Figure 2: The data construction pipeline of CodeCap-Bench. The pipeline comprises three stages: multi-source video collection, content filtering for structured 2D videos, and fine-grained annotation with human review, covering static and dynamic focal points and object-level spatio-temporal information.
blocks.zh: 图 2: CodeCap-Bench的数据构建管道. 管道由三个阶段组成:多源视频收集,结构化2D视频的内容过滤,以及精细的带有人文评论的注释,涵盖静态和动态的联络点和对象级的时空信息.

blocks.en:
Visual similarity measures the overall visual consistency between the reference and rendered videos.
We apply identical temporal sampling and preprocessing to both videos and extract their representations using the pretrained V-JEPA 2.1 [ Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ] ViT-Gigantic-384 model.
We then compute the cosine similarity between the resulting video features to assess their global similarity in visual content, appearance, and motion patterns.
blocks.zh:
视觉相似度衡量了参考和制作的视频的整体视觉一致性.
我们对视频进行相同的时间取样和预处理,并使用经过预先训练的V-JEPA2.1[Mur-Labadia等人,2026年]VIT-Gigantic-384型号提取其表述。
然后我们计算所生成的视频功能之间的余弦相似性,以评估它们在视觉内容,外观和运动模式上的全球相似性.

blocks.en:
Object-level spatio-temporal IoU measures the spatial and temporal alignment of key objects between the reference and rendered videos.
For each annotated reference object, GPT-6-sol [ OpenAI, 2026c ] identifies its visible interval in the rendered video, selects representative frames, and generates bounding boxes along with positive and negative point prompts to guide video segmentation with SAM 3.1 [ Meta AI, 2026 ] .
We extract per-frame bounding boxes from the segmentation results and compute their IoU with the reference annotations on a shared timeline.
The IoU is averaged over frames where the object is visible in either video, with a score of zero when the object is absent from the rendered video.
We report the object score by averaging object-level IoU scores first within each video, then across all videos.
blocks.zh:
对象级别时空 IoU测量关键物体在空间和时间上的参照与制作的视频的一致。
对于每个注解的参考对象,GPT-6-sol[OpenAI, 2026c]在渲染的视频中识别其可见的间隔,选择具有代表性的帧,并生成边框以及正负点提示,以引导视频与 SAM 分割 3.1 [Meta AI, 2026] (中文(简体) ).
我们从分解结果中提取每个框的框,并用一个共用时间表上的参考说明来计算它们的IoU.
IoU在任何视频中均可见对象的帧上平均,当对象不在渲染的视频中时得分为零.
我们通过平均对象等级IoU分数来报告对象分数,首先在每段视频中,然后在所有视频中。

blocks.en:
Fine-grained visual information retention measures how faithfully a code caption preserves the static and dynamic visual content specified by annotated focal points.
For each focal point, GPT-6-sol [ OpenAI, 2026c ] receives the corresponding reference segment, the focal point’s textual description, and the full rendered video.
Based on these inputs, it assigns an integer score from 0 0 to 5 5 to indicate how faithfully the specified content is reproduced.
Static focal points concern appearance, layout, and spatial relationships, while dynamic focal points concern state changes, motion processes, pacing, and temporal coordination.
Higher scores indicate more faithful information retention, with 0 0 indicating that the relevant content is not substantively reproduced.
As with object-level spatio-temporal IoU, scores are averaged within each video and then across all videos.
blocks.zh:
精细的视觉信息保留量测量代码标题如何忠实地保存附加说明的焦点指定的静态和动态视觉内容.
对于每个焦点,GPT-6-sol [OpenAI, 2026c] 接收相应的参考段,焦点的文字描述,以及完整的渲染视频.
基于这些投入,它分配了一个0到5 5的整数分数,以表明指定的内容是如何忠实地复制的.
静态联络点涉及外观、布局和空间关系,而动态联络点则涉及状态变化、运动过程、速度和时间协调。
较高的分数表明信息保存更加忠实,0表示相关内容没有实质复制.
与对象层面的sptio-时空IoU一样,每个视频内部的分数平均,然后跨过所有视频.

blocks.en: 3.3 Data Construction
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 数据构建

blocks.en:
We construct CodeCap-Bench through a three-stage pipeline comprising multi-source video collection, content filtering, and fine-grained annotation with human review, as illustrated in Figure 2 .
We focus on structured 2D videos, where fine-grained visual details, spatial layouts, and temporal dynamics are central to the visual content.
The explicit structure of these videos facilitates fine-grained annotation and comparison between reference and rendered videos.
These videos exhibit diverse and complex visual structures and dynamic patterns, providing a well-defined setting for evaluating how faithfully models can express visual information and spatio-temporal relationships through executable code.
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,我们通过一个三阶段管道构建了CodeCap-Bench,其中包括多源视频收集、内容过滤和精细的注解。
我们专注于结构化的2D视频,其中精细的视觉细节,空间布局,以及时间动态是视觉内容的核心.
这些视频的清晰结构便利了精细的注释和参考与制作的视频的比较。
这些视频展现了多样而复杂的视觉结构和动态模式,为评价模型如何通过可执行代码忠实地表达视觉信息和时空关系提供了一个清晰的设定.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Statistics of CodeCap-Bench. (a) Video counts and proportions across five categories. (b) Video duration distribution. (c) Reference objects per video. (d) Static and dynamic focal points per video.
blocks.zh: 图3:Bench密码统计。 (a) 视频计数和五个类别的比例。 (b) 视频时间分布。 (c) 每部视频的参考对象。 (d) 每部录像有静态和动态的协调人。

blocks.en:
We collect candidate videos from public platforms, including Bilibili, YouTube, Behance, and Vimeo, covering five categories: desktop and application interfaces, 2D games, visual design and media animation, data and scientific visualization, and icons and abstract motion graphics.
These categories encompass diverse visual content and dynamic patterns, including window operations, page scrolling, object motion, dynamic charts, geometric construction, and shape transformations.
blocks.zh:
我们从包括bilibili,YouTube,Behance和Vimeo在内的公共平台收集候选视频,涵盖五个类别:桌面和应用界面,2D游戏,视觉设计和媒体动画,数据和科学可视化,以及图标和抽象运动图形.
这些类别包括多种视觉内容和动态模式,包括窗口操作,页面滚动,对象运动,动态图表,几何构造,以及形状转换.

blocks.en:
Candidate videos are filtered by scene geometry, appearance complexity, and motion structure.
We retain videos dominated by 2D layouts, shapes, text, and explicit object trajectories, while excluding those dominated by complex 3D viewpoints, detailed textures, or dense pixel-level dynamics.
This selection keeps the benchmark focused on visual content amenable to programmatic representation.
blocks.zh:
候选视频通过场景几何,外观复杂,运动结构进行过滤.
我们保留了以2D布局,形状,文字,和明确对象轨迹为主的视频,同时排除了以复杂3D视角,详细纹理,或密集像素级动态为主的视频.
这一选择使基准的重点放在可视内容上,便于方案表述。

blocks.en:
We provide two types of annotations: focal-point annotations and object-level spatio-temporal annotations.
Each focal-point annotation identifies a key static feature or dynamic process, with a description and corresponding timestamps in the reference video.
Static focal points capture the appearance, composition, spatial relationships, and text presentation of visual elements, while dynamic focal points capture state changes, motion processes, rhythm, and temporal coordination among objects.
Object-level spatio-temporal annotations record the visible intervals and per-frame bounding boxes of key objects.
We obtain spatial annotations through video segmentation model guided by bounding-box prompts together with positive/negative point prompts on representative frames.
All annotations undergo human review and correction.
Reviewers assess whether focal points are representative, accurately described, and correctly localized in time.
Object-level annotations are checked for consistent object identities, correct visible intervals, and accurate spatial boundaries.
blocks.zh:
我们提供两类说明:焦点说明和对象级的时空说明。
每个焦点注释都确定了一个关键的静态特征或动态过程,在参考视频中有描述和相应的时间戳.
静态焦点捕捉视觉元素的外观,组成,空间关系和文本呈现,而动态焦点捕捉物体之间的状态变化,运动过程,节奏和时间协调.
对象级spatio-时序注释记录了关键对象的可见间隔和每帧边框.
我们通过视频分解模型获得空间说明,这些模型以边框-框提示以及代表性框架上的正/负点提示为指导。
所有说明都要经过人文审查和修正。
审查者评估协调人是否具有代表性、描述是否准确、是否及时正确。
检查对象级别说明是否具有一致的对象身份、正确的可见间隔和准确的空间界限。

blocks.en: 3.4 Dataset Statistics
blocks.zh: 3.4 数据集统计

blocks.en:
Figure 3 (a–b) shows the distributions of video categories and durations.
CodeCap-Bench comprises 323 323 videos across five categories of structured 2D content.
The videos have a mean duration of 19.0 19.0 seconds and a median duration of 17.0 17.0 seconds.
In comparison, Animation2Code [ Ji et al., 2026 ] focuses on CodePen web animations with an average duration of 5.1 5.1 seconds.
CodeCap-Bench covers a broader range of structured 2D content and longer temporal sequences, allowing evaluation across more diverse visual structures and dynamic patterns.
Figure 3 (c–d) shows the distributions of object and focal-point counts per video.
Each video contains an average of 16.8 16.8 annotated objects and 8.6 8.6 static and dynamic focal points.
The annotated focal-point intervals have a mean duration of 3.3 3.3 seconds and a median of 1.8 1.8 seconds.
blocks.zh:
图3(a-b)显示视频类别和持续时间的分布情况。
CodeCap-Bench包含323,323个视频,涉及五类结构化的2D内容.
视频的平均持续时间为19.0秒19.0,中间持续时间为17.0 17.0秒.
相比之下,动画2Code[Ji等人,2026年]专注于CodePen网络动画,平均持续时间为5.1秒.
CodeCap-Bench涵盖范围更广的结构化2D内容和更长的时间序列,允许在更多样化的视觉结构和动态模式中进行评价.
图3(c-d)显示每个视频的物体和焦点的分布情况。
每段视频平均包含16.8 16.8个注解对象和8.6 8.6个静态和动态焦点.
附加说明的焦距平均长度为3.33.3秒,中位数为1.81.8秒.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
Our experiments aim to understand how faithfully current MLLMs can express video content through executable code, particularly in preserving fine-grained visual details, spatial structures, and temporal dynamics.
We further investigate how agentic workflows and reasoning effort affect code captioning fidelity, and examine the trade-offs among visual fidelity, generation reliability, and computational cost.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验旨在了解当前MLLM如何忠实地通过可执行代码来表达视频内容,特别是在保存精细的视觉细节,空间结构和时间动态方面.
我们进一步调查代理工作流程和推理工作如何影响代码标题的忠实,并审查视觉忠诚、生成可靠性和计算成本之间的权衡。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Table 1: Main results on CodeCap-Bench. All configurations use medium thinking effort. Bold values indicate the best results within the Agentic and Non-agentic groups, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表1: 编码Cap-Bench的主要结果。 所有配置都使用中度思维努力. 粗体值分别表明物剂组和非物剂组内的最佳结果。

blocks.en:
Models and generation settings. We evaluate 7 7 MLLMs: GPT-6-astra [ OpenAI, 2026b ] , GPT-6-sol [ OpenAI, 2026c ] , GPT-5.6-sol [ OpenAI, 2026a ] , Qwen3.8-max [ Qwen Team, 2026 ] , DeepSeek-v4.1-flash [ DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ] , Opus-5 [ Anthropic, 2026 ] , and Gemini-3.8-flash [ Google DeepMind, 2026 ] .
In the agentic setting, we evaluate models using Pi Agent, Codex, or Claude Code as the agent harness.
Models can inspect reference frames through tool calls, generate executable code, and iteratively refine their implementations using rendering feedback.
In the non-agentic setting, models generate code in a single pass from sampled video frames and the task prompt, without tool calls or rendering feedback.
blocks.zh:
模型与生成设置. 我们评估了7 7 MLLM:GPT-6-astra [OpenAI, 2026b], GPT-6-索尔 [OpenAI, 2026c], GPT-5.6-索尔 [OpenAI, 2026a], Quen3.8-max [Quen Team, 2026], DeepSeek-v4.1-flash (英语). [DeepSeek-AI, 2026], Opus-5 [Anthropic, 2026],和双子座-3.8-flash [Google DeepMind, 2026].
在代理设定中,我们用Pi Agent, Codex, 或Claude Code作为代理带来评价模型.
模型可以通过工具调用检查参考框架,生成可执行代码,并利用提供反馈来迭代完善其执行.
在非代理设定中,模型从抽样的视频帧和任务提示器中以单传生成代码,没有工具调用或反馈.

blocks.en:
Input format. In the agentic setting, models access the reference video through tools and select timestamps for frame inspection.
In the non-agentic setting, reference videos are uniformly sampled at 2 fps.
When sampled frames exceeds the 50-image API limit for GPT models, we arrange them into temporally ordered image grids to retain all sampled frames.
Other models receive the sampled frames directly.
blocks.zh:
输入格式。 在代理设置中,模型通过工具访问参考视频,并选择时间戳进行帧检查.
在非特效设定中,参考视频在2 fps中统一取样.
当被采样的帧超过GPT模型的50-image API限制时,我们将它们排列成按时间排序的图像网格,以保留所有被采样的帧.
其他模型则直接接收样本框.

blocks.en:
Evaluation metrics. Following Section 3.2 , we evaluate code caption fidelity using visual similarity, object-level spatio-temporal IoU, and fine-grained visual information retention.
We further report static and dynamic retention scores to distinguish the preservation of visual appearance and spatial structure from that of motion and temporal relationships.
We additionally report the video production success rate, defined as the percentage of tasks that successfully produce a rendered video.
Tasks that fail to produce a video receive zero scores for all metrics.
blocks.zh:
评价尺度。 第3.2节之后,我们利用视觉相似性、物体水平的时空IoU以及精细的视觉信息保留来评估代码标题的忠实性。
我们进一步报告静态和动态保留分数,以区分视觉外观和空间结构与运动和时间关系。
我们还报告视频制作成功率,即成功制作视频的任务百分比。
未制作视频的任务,所有度量标准都获得零分.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Table 1 presents the performance of different models and generation configurations at medium thinking effort.
GPT-6-astra achieves the highest overall fine-grained visual information retention in both agentic and non-agentic settings.
With Codex, it reaches 73.24 73.24 in overall retention and 75.37 75.37 in object-level spatio-temporal IoU, outperforming the next-best model, Opus-5 with Pi Agent, by 14.40 14.40 points in overall retention.
Other models exhibit substantial performance differences despite similarly high video production success rates.
For example, with Codex, GPT-6-sol achieves a 100% success rate but only 51.34 in overall retention, compared with 73.24 for GPT-6-astra at a 99.4% success rate.
These results indicate that successful video production does not necessarily imply faithful preservation of visual information.
blocks.zh:
表1列出了不同模型和生成配置在中等思维努力中的性能.
GPT-6-astra在介质和非介质设置中都实现了最高的整体细纹视觉信息保留.
与Codex一起,它的总保留量达到73.24 73.24,在物体级的spatio-时空IoU中达到75.37 75.37,比次佳型号Opus-5与Pi Agent相比,总保留量达到14.40 14.40分.
其他模型的性能差异很大,尽管视频制作成功率也很高。
例如,通过Codex,GPT-6-sol取得了100%的成功率,但总体保留率只有51.34%,而GPT-6-astra的成功率为99.4%。
这些结果表明,成功的视频制作并不一定意味着忠实地保存视觉信息.

blocks.en:
Across all evaluated configurations, dynamic visual information is consistently less faithfully preserved than static content.
For example, GPT-6-astra with Codex achieves 80.72 in static retention but only 68.61 in dynamic retention, while GPT-6-sol with Codex shows a larger gap between 64.04 and 43.92.
This pattern holds across different models and generation settings, highlighting the difficulty of accurately expressing temporal dynamics through executable code.
blocks.zh:
在所有评估的配置中,动态视觉信息始终不如静态内容忠实。
例如,带有Codex的GPT-6-astra在静态保留中实现了80.72,但只有68.61在动态保留中实现,而带有Codex的GPT-6-sol在64.04和43.92之间差距较大.
这种模式贯穿不同的模型和生成设置,凸显出通过可执行代码准确表达时间动态的难度.

blocks.en:
Agentic generation consistently improves video production success rates but does not always improve visual fidelity.
Compared with non-agentic generation, Qwen3.8-max with Pi Agent improves its success rate from 82.0% to 93.2% and overall retention from 44.67 to 48.83.
In contrast, GPT-6-sol and GPT-5.6-sol achieve lower overall retention with both tested agent harnesses than in the non-agentic setting.
These results suggest that the benefits of agentic generation for code captioning fidelity depend on the model and generation configuration.
blocks.zh:
代理生成持续提高视频制作成功率,但并不总是提高视觉忠诚度.
与非物剂生成相比,与Pi Agent的Quen3.8-max提高了成功率,从82.0%提高到93.2%,整体保留率从44.67%提高到48.83.
相比之下,GPT-6-sol和GPT-5.6-sol在两种经过测试的剂系下的总体保留率都低于非剂系下。
这些结果表明,代理生成对于代码标题忠诚性的好处取决于模型和生成配置.

blocks.en:
Figure 4 compares code captioning performance across five video categories for four models using Pi Agent at medium thinking effort.
GPT-6-astra leads in every category on both object-level spatio-temporal IoU and overall fine-grained visual information retention.
All four models achieve their highest object-level spatio-temporal IoU in the “Data and Scientific Visualization” category.
For overall retention, all four models perform better on “Desktop and Application Interfaces” and “Data and Scientific Visualization” than on either “Visual Design and Media Animation” or “Icons and Abstract Motion Graphics.”
These results highlight differences in code captioning fidelity across video categories.
blocks.zh:
图4比较了Pi Agent在中思力下对四个型号的五个视频类别的代码字幕性能.
GPT-6-astra在对象层次的spatio-时空IoU和总体精细的视觉信息保留上,在每一个类别中都领先.
所有四个模型都实现了“数据与科学可视化”类中最高的天体级偶联。
就总体保留而言,所有四个模型在“Desktop和应用程序接口”和“数据与科学可视化”方面的表现都优于“视觉设计和媒体动画”或“Icons和抽象运动图形”。 “
这些结果凸显了不同视频类别之间对忠诚的代码标题的差异。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Average scores of four models across video categories. Across all four models, overall visual information retention is higher for desktop and application interfaces and data and scientific visualization than for visual design and media animation and icons and abstract motion graphics.
blocks.zh: 图4:跨视频类四个模型的平均分数. 在所有四个模型中,对于桌面和应用界面以及数据和科学可视化而言,总体的视觉信息保留率高于视觉设计和媒体动画以及图标和抽象运动图形.

blocks.en: 4.3 Further Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 进一步分析

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Effect of Thinking Effort
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 思考努力的效果

blocks.en: Figure 5: Visual fidelity and generation cost across different thinking effort levels using the Pi Agent harness. (a) GPT-6-sol; (b) Qwen3.8-max. The left axis shows object-level spatio-temporal IoU and fine-grained visual information retention, while the right axis shows average generation cost.
blocks.zh: 图5:使用Pi Agent带不同思维水平的视觉忠诚和生成成本。 (a) GPT-6-Sol; (b) Quen3.8-max。 左轴显示对象级spatio-时空IoU和精细的视觉信息保留,而右轴显示平均生成成本.

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 5 , increasing thinking effort improves code captioning fidelity for both models, but the magnitude of improvement and the associated generation cost differ.
For GPT-6-sol, increasing thinking effort from medium to xhigh raises object-level spatio-temporal IoU from 50.42 to 67.13 and fine-grained visual information retention from 47.53 to 63.29.
Meanwhile, the average generation cost increases from USD 0.315 to USD 1.409, indicating that substantial fidelity gains come with considerably higher costs.
blocks.zh:
如图5所示,越来越多的思维努力改进了两种模型的忠实性编码标题,但改进的程度和相关生成成本各不相同。
对于GPT-6-sol,从中高到x高的思维能力不断提高,将对象级的spatio-时空IoU从50.42提高到67.13,细纹视觉信息保留从47.53提高到63.29.
同时,平均生成成本从0.315美元增至1.409美元,表明大量忠诚收益的成本要高得多。

blocks.en:
For Qwen3.8-max, most improvements occur when thinking effort increases from low to medium, with spatio-temporal IoU rising from 36.05 to 48.90 and visual information retention from 42.02 to 48.83.
Further increasing effort to xhigh yields smaller gains of 2.67 and 2.72 points, respectively, while the average generation cost increases from USD 0.922 to USD 1.129.
These results reveal model-dependent returns to increased thinking effort, with GPT-6-sol maintaining larger fidelity gains at higher effort levels than Qwen3.8-max.
blocks.zh:
对Qwen3.8-max来说,大部分改进发生在思维努力从低到中增加,时空IoU从36.05升至48.90,视觉信息保留从42.02升至48.83.
进一步加大x高水平的努力分别产生2.67分和2.72分的较小收益,而平均发电成本从0.922美元增加到1.129美元。
这些结果表明,依赖模型的思维能力得到提高,GPT-6-Sol在比Qune3.8-max更高的努力水平上保持更大的忠诚度收益。

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Generation Cost and Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 生成成本和效率

blocks.en: Figure 6: Generation cost and efficiency with the Pi Agent harness.
blocks.zh: 图6:Pi Agent带的生成成本和效率。

blocks.en:
We examine the relationship between code captioning fidelity, generation cost, and runtime efficiency across models using the Pi Agent harness.
As shown in Figure 6 , higher generation cost does not consistently translate into better caption fidelity.
For example, GPT-6-astra achieves an overall visual information retention score of 72.87 at a substantially lower estimated cost than Opus-5, which scores 58.84.
Qwen3.8-max and DeepSeek-v4.1-flash also achieve comparable or higher retention scores than some other models at lower estimated costs, indicating that monetary cost alone does not determine captioning performance.
blocks.zh:
我们用 Pi Agent 的绳索来研究 代码标题、生成成本和运行效率之间的关系。
如图6所示,较高的生成成本并非一贯地转化为更好的标题。
例如,GPT-6-astra以比Opus-5低得多的估计费用达到总的视觉信息保留分72.87分,后者得分58.84分.
Qune3.8-max和DeepSeek-v4.1-flash也以较低的估计成本实现了比其他模型的可比或更高的保留分数,表明单靠货币成本不能决定标题性能.

blocks.en:
However, lower generation cost does not necessarily imply greater runtime efficiency.
Qwen3.8-max and DeepSeek-v4.1-flash take an average of 42.1 and 50.1 minutes per video, respectively, compared with 12.5 minutes for GPT-6-astra.
They also consume more tokens and involve more model response rounds than the GPT series.
These results highlight the differences between monetary cost, token consumption, and generation time when evaluating the efficiency of code captioning systems.
blocks.zh:
然而,低发电成本并不一定意味着提高运行时间效率。
Qune3.8-max和DeepSeek-v4.1-flash分别需要42.1分钟和50.1分钟的视频,而GPT-6-astra则需要12.5分钟.
它们也比GPT系列消耗更多的代币,并涉及更多的模型响应回合.
这些结果突出了在评价代码标题系统的效率时货币成本、象征性消费和生成时间之间的差异。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Tool call composition for seven models with the Pi Agent harness.
blocks.zh: 图7:使用Pi Agent吊带的7种模型的工具调用成分.

blocks.en: 4.3.3 Tool Usage Behavior
blocks.zh: 4.3.3 工具使用行为

blocks.en:
Figure 7 compares the tool usage patterns of seven models under the same Pi Agent harness.
GPT-6-sol and GPT-5.6-sol devote approximately half of their tool calls to directly viewing reference frames, while Gemini-3.8-flash allocates 46.8% of its calls to extracting and analyzing frames.
Qwen3.8-max has the highest proportion of rendering and comparison calls at 30.9%, indicating greater emphasis on inspecting generated results.
These differences show that models distribute their tool calls differently across reference observation, frame analysis, and rendering feedback, even under the same agent harness.
blocks.zh:
图7比较了同一Pi Agent吊带下七个模型的工具使用模式.
GPT-6-sol和GPT-5.6-sol将大约一半的工具调用用于直接查看参考帧,而双子座-3.8-flash则分配46.8%的调用用于提取和分析帧.
Qune3.8-max的渲染和比较呼叫比例最高,为30.9%,表明更加强调检查生成的结果.
这些差异表明,各模型分发其工具在参考观测、框架分析和反馈之间呼唤不同,甚至在同一个代理工具下也是如此。

blocks.en:
The total number of tool calls also varies considerably across models, but more calls do not necessarily correspond to higher caption fidelity.
For example, GPT-6-astra achieves an overall visual information retention score of 72.87 with an average of 47.4 tool calls per video, whereas Gemini-3.8-flash scores 47.73 with 99.6 calls.
These results suggest that tool usage frequency alone is insufficient to characterize the effectiveness of agentic code captioning.
blocks.zh:
不同模型的工具呼叫总数也相差很大,但更多的呼叫不一定对应较高的标题忠贞.
例如,GPT-6-astra实现了总的视觉信息保留分72.87分,每段视频平均有47.4个工具呼叫,而双子座-3.8-flash得分47.73分99.6个呼叫.
这些结果表明,仅工具使用频率不足以说明代理编码标题的有效性。

blocks.en: 4.3.4 Validity of the Evaluation Metric
blocks.zh: 4.3.4 评价计量的有效性

blocks.en: Figure 8: Scores from different judge models and their correlation with human scores . The two judge configurations yield the same overall ranking for the two evaluated generation models, and GPT-6-sol judge scores correlate strongly with human scores (Pearson r=0.942).
blocks.zh: 图8:不同评委模型的分数及其与人类分数的相关性 这两个评委配置对两个被评价的一代模型的总体排名相同,GPT-6-sol评委的分数与人类的分数密切相关(Pearson r=0.942).

blocks.en:
Figure 8 (a) compares fine-grained visual information retention scores assigned by GPT-6-sol and Gemini-3.1-pro-preview to outputs generated by GPT-6-sol and DeepSeek-v4.1-flash using Pi Agent at medium thinking effort.
Both judges use the same focal-point annotations, scoring criteria, and temporal sampling rate of 2 fps.
GPT receives sampled frames as individual images or image grids, while Gemini processes video inputs at their native spatial resolution.
Although their absolute scores differ, both judges assign higher overall retention scores to GPT-6-sol than to DeepSeek-v4.1-flash, showing consistent relative assessments for the two evaluated models.
blocks.zh:
图8 (a)将GPT-6-sol和双子座3.1-pro-review指定的细纹视觉信息保留分数与GPT-6-sol和DeepSeek-v4.1-flash在中等思维努力时使用Pi Agent生成的输出进行对比.
两位法官都使用相同的焦点说明,评分标准,以及2 fps的时间采样率.
GPT作为单个图像或图像网格接收样本帧,而双子座则按其本土空间分辨率处理视频输入.
虽然他们的绝对分数不同,但两位法官都给GPT-6-Sol分配的总保留分数高于给DeepSeek-v4.1-flash分配的总保留分数,显示对两个被评价模型的相对评估一致.

blocks.en:
To assess alignment with human judgments, we sample 50 reference videos, with 10 from each category, and evaluate outputs generated by GPT-6-astra, Opus-5, Qwen3.8-max, and DeepSeek-v4.1-flash using Pi Agent.
Human annotators compare the generated videos with the corresponding reference segments and score each focal point using the same 0–5 criteria as our evaluation metric.
We aggregate focal-point scores into video-level scores and compute the Pearson correlation between human and GPT-6-sol judge scores for the same generated outputs.
As shown in Figure 8 (b), the Pearson correlation coefficient reaches 0.942, indicating strong alignment between MLLM-based evaluation and human assessments of visual information retention.
blocks.zh:
为了评估与人类判断的一致性,我们抽取了50个参考视频,每个类别有10个,并评价了GPT-6-astra,Opus-5,Quen3.8-max以及DeepSeek-v4.1-flash使用Pi Agent生成的输出.
使用与我们评价标准相同的0比5标准,
我们把焦点分数汇总到视频级别分数中,并计算同一产出的人类和GPT-6-sol评委分数之间的皮尔逊关联.
如图8(b)所示,皮尔逊相关系数达到0.942,表明基于MLLM的评价与人类对视觉信息保留评估之间的紧密一致.

blocks.en: 4.3.5 Execution Trace Example
blocks.zh: 4.3.5 执行追踪实例

blocks.en:
Figure 9 illustrates how GPT-6-astra uses the Codex harness to generate and refine a code caption for a bubble chart video.
The model first separates static interface elements from dynamic objects and uses color segmentation to estimate bubble centers and radii.
It then detects year transitions through frame differences and tracks the pointer using template matching.
These measurements are combined with the fixed layout to generate the animation.
By comparing the rendered and reference frames at the same timestamp, the model identifies a one-year offset in the slider and corrects its position.
This example illustrates how tool-assisted visual analysis extracts structured spatio-temporal information for code generation, while rendering feedback helps detect and correct temporal misalignment.
blocks.zh:
图9说明了GPT-6-astra如何利用Codex带生成和完善泡图视频的代码标题.
该模型首先将静态界面元素与动态对象区分开来,并使用颜色分割来估计气泡中心和光度.
然后通过帧差异检测年份过渡,并使用模板匹配跟踪指针.
这些测量与固定布局结合生成动画.
通过在相同的时间戳上比较渲染和参考框架,模型在滑盘中确定一个一年的抵消,并纠正其位置.
这个例子说明了工具辅助的视觉分析如何提取结构化的spatio-时空信息用于代码生成,同时提供反馈有助于检测和纠正时间错位.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Execution trace of GPT-6-astra reconstructing a bubble chart video with the Codex harness.
blocks.zh: 图 9:执行追踪GPT-6-astra 重建带Codex带的气泡图视频.

blocks.en: 4.3.6 Comparing Code and Natural Language Captions
blocks.zh: 4.3.6 比较代码和自然语言说明

blocks.en:
We randomly select 100 videos with question–answer annotations from DVBench [ Wang et al., 2026a ] , VideoMathQA [ Rasheed et al., 2026 ] , and GUI-World [ Chen et al., 2025a ] to compare the information retained by code and natural language captions.
For each video, GPT-5.6-sol, Opus-5, and Qwen3.8-max generate both types of captions.
Gemini-3.8-flash answers the annotated questions using either the video rendered from the code caption or the natural language caption, and its predictions are evaluated against ground-truth answers.
We also report its accuracy when answering directly from the original videos as a reference.
blocks.zh:
我们随机从DV Bench [Wang et al., 2026a], VideoMathQA [Rasheed et al., 2026], 以及GUI-World [Chen et al., 2025a] 中选择100个带问答说明的视频,
对于每段视频,GPT-5.6-sol,Opus-5和Qune3.8-max生成两种标题.
双子座-3.8-flash用代码标题或自然语言标题提供的视频来回答附加说明的问题,其预测根据地面真实的答案来评价。
我们还报告在直接从原始视频中回答时的准确性,作为参考。

blocks.en: Table 2: Question-answering accuracy (%) from rendered videos and caption text.
blocks.zh: 表2:从提供的视频和字幕文本中回答的准确性(%)。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 2 , code-rendered videos achieve higher question-answering accuracy than natural language captions across all three caption models.
The improvements range from 2.83 to 10.38 percentage points, with Opus-5 showing the largest gain.
Its code-rendered videos achieve 83.02% accuracy, approaching the 83.96% obtained from the original videos.
These results suggest that, under the evaluated setting, code captions preserve more information useful for answering the annotated questions.
blocks.zh:
如表2所示,编码视频在所有三个标题模型中实现了高于自然语言标题的回答精度。
改进幅度在2.83至10.38个百分点之间,Opus-5显示的收益最大.
它的代号视频达到了83.02%的精度,接近从原始视频中获得的83.96%.
这些结果表明,在经过评价的设定下,代码标题保存了更多有助于回答附加说明的问题的信息。

blocks.en:
We further compare the reconstruction fidelity of code and natural language captions on CodeCap-Bench.
Code captions are directly rendered into videos, while natural language captions are converted into videos using Seedance-2.5 [ ByteDance Seed, 2026 ] .
We evaluate reconstruction fidelity using Appearance Similarity (AS), Motion Pattern Similarity (MPS), and Keyframe Structural Similarity (KSS).
Each reference video is divided into shots, which are matched with corresponding segments in the generated video.
AS measures DreamSim [ Fu et al., 2023 ] feature similarity, MPS compares the directions and magnitudes of point displacements tracked by CoTracker3 [ Karaev et al., 2025 ] , and KSS computes SSIM [ Wang et al., 2004 ] between each reference shot’s midpoint frame and its matched generated frame.
Scores are averaged across shots within each video and then across videos.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步比较了密码的重建忠贞度和本奇密码的自然语言标题。
代码字幕直接被制成视频,而自然语言字幕则使用Speedance-2.5[byteDance Seed, 2026]转换成视频.
我们利用外观相似性(AS),运动模式相似性(MPS)和键框结构相似性(KSS)来评价重建忠诚性.
每个参考视频被分为镜头,镜头与生成的视频中相应的片段相匹配.
作为措施 DreamSim [Fu 等人, 2023] 具有相似性, MPS比较了 CoTracker3 [Karaev等人, 2025] 所跟踪的点位移的方向和大小, KSS计算了每个参考点的中点框与其对应的生成框之间的SSIM [Wang等人, 2004].
每段录像中平均得分,然后是录像。

blocks.en: Table 3: Video reconstruction fidelity from code and natural language captions.
blocks.zh: 表3:从代码和自然语言标题中录制的视频重建忠贞度。

blocks.en:
Table 3 shows that code rendering consistently achieves higher scores across all three metrics and caption models.
The gains are particularly pronounced in appearance and structural similarity, with AS increasing by 0.20–0.23 and KSS by 0.18–0.22.
Motion pattern similarity also improves, although the numerical gains are smaller.
Unlike natural language captions, which require a separate generative model to produce visual content, executable code explicitly specifies how visual elements are constructed and evolve over time.
These results highlight the potential of code captions to preserve fine-grained visual information and spatio-temporal structure through an explicit and executable representation.
blocks.zh:
表3显示,所有三个度量和标题模型的代码渲染都始终能达到更高的分数。
这些收益在外观和结构相似性方面特别显著,AS增加了0.20-0.23,KSS增加了0.18-0.22。
运动模式的相似性也有所改善,尽管数字收益较小。
与自然语言字幕不同的是,需要单独的基因模型来制作视觉内容,可执行代码明确规定视觉元素如何构建并随时间演变.
这些结果突出了代码标题通过明确和可执行的表示来保存精细的视觉信息和时空结构的潜力.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we explore the potential of executable code as a complementary representation for video captioning and introduce CodeCap-Bench to systematically evaluate the code captioning capabilities of MLLMs.
Focusing on structured 2D videos, CodeCap-Bench comprises diverse video samples, fine-grained annotations, and a multi-level evaluation framework for assessing visual and spatio-temporal fidelity.
Our experiments show that executable code better preserves visual information than natural language captions in question answering and video reconstruction.
These results suggest that code can serve as a promising complementary representation for video captioning.
Meanwhile, evaluations on CodeCap-Bench reveal that leading proprietary MLLMs demonstrate promising code captioning capabilities but still struggle to capture complex temporal dynamics, while open-source models exhibit substantial performance gaps.
We further find that agentic workflows improve rendering success rates but do not consistently enhance caption fidelity.
Together, these findings highlight both the promise of executable code for video captioning and the challenges of generating faithful code captions, providing a foundation for future research on structured video representations.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们探索可执行代码作为视频字幕的辅助表现的潜力,并引入CodeCap-Bench系统评价MLLMs的代码字幕能力.
以结构化的2D视频为主,CodeCap-Bench包含各种视频样本,精细的说明,以及评估视觉和时空忠诚度的多层次评价框架.
我们的实验显示,可执行代码比在回答和视频重建中的自然语言标题更好地保存视觉信息.
这些结果表明,代码可以作为视频字幕的有希望的补充说明。
同时,对CodeCap-Bench的评价表明,领先的专有MLLMs显示出很有希望的代码字幕能力,但仍难以捕捉复杂的时间动态,而开源模型显示出巨大的性能差距。
我们还发现,代理工作流程提高了成功率,但并没有始终如一地提高标题的忠诚度。
这些结论共同突出了视频字幕可执行代码的希望和生成忠实代码标题的挑战,为未来对结构化视频表达的研究奠定了基础.

blocks.en: Reference video: /input/reference.mp4 Recreate the entire reference video, from the first frame to the last. The recreation must have the same total duration as the reference video. The recreation starts at 0 seconds, and its timeline must align with the reference video’s timeline. seek(seconds) takes a time on this shared timeline, from 0 through the video’s total duration. Use matching timestamps when extracting reference frames and inspecting the generated page. Task Recreate the visuals and all changes over time in the entire reference video using only HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Preserve the original aspect ratio, main content, composition, and timing. Visual implementation constraints All visual content must be generated using DOM/CSS, Canvas drawing commands, inline SVG, or procedural WebGL. This includes backgrounds, text, icons, illustrations, software interfaces, and controls. The reference video and extracted frames are for observation only and must not be used in the final rendering. Do not use video, full-frame or cropped screenshots, external images, AI-generated images, glyph atlases, extracted textures, or external fonts. Do not circumvent these restrictions by embedding reference imagery as Base64 data, pixel arrays, per-pixel drawing primitives, automatically traced shapes, or similar representations. Render text from actual strings using the browser’s text layout engine or Canvas fillText/strokeText. You may use fonts already installed on the system. Rebuild interfaces, controls, illustrations, and textures in code, preserving their main content, composition, and colors. Do not simply omit them or replace them with unrelated placeholders. Preserve the motion and transition timing of the reference video. Do not replace continuous motion with cuts between a few static images. Workflow and environment The working directory is /workspace. First extract reference frames yourself and inspect them with read, then write the code. Next, compare browser screenshots against the reference frames and iteratively refine the implementation, covering the main scenes and transitions. Do not infer the visuals from filenames alone. The environment comes with ffprobe, ffmpeg, Python, Node, and Chromium preinstalled. Playwright is available at /opt/runtime/browser/node_modules/playwright. Run Python scripts with the python command. Direct internet access is unavailable. Do not download or install additional dependencies. Store reference frames for inspection, comparison screenshots, and validation scripts in /workspace/checks/. Store temporary files in /tmp. Example screenshot command (at the start of both the recreation and the reference video): node /opt/tools/capture.mjs /workspace/index.html 0 /workspace/checks/frame.png To inspect other times, replace 0 in the command with a specific timestamp in seconds, from 0 through the video’s total duration. The command accepts a numeric value, not an arithmetic expression. Delivery requirements Save the entire implementation in /workspace/index.html, with no dependencies on other files or network resources. The page must play automatically when opened and scale to fit the window while preserving its aspect ratio. Expose window.videoCompare = { duration, width, height, seek(seconds) { /* Pause playback and render the requested time. */ } }, where duration is the reference video’s actual total duration in seconds, and width and height match its dimensions in pixels. seek(seconds) must pause the playback clock and reliably render the requested time, including when calls arrive out of chronological order or repeatedly target the same time. The deliverable must run in an isolated environment containing only index.html, without reading checks/ or the reference video. In your final response, state the entry point, how to open it, what validation you performed, and any remaining differences caused by approximations in the code-only recreation.

blocks.en: C.2 Non-Agentic Code Generation Prompt
blocks.zh: C.2 非代理代码生成提示

blocks.en: Reference input: the supplied frames sampled from the reference video and the accompanying video dimensions, total duration, and frame timestamps. If frames are arranged in collages, use the supplied layout and timestamp labels to identify each frame and its place in the timeline. Recreate the entire reference video, from the first frame to the last. The recreation must have the same total duration as the reference video. The recreation starts at 0 seconds, and its timeline must align with the reference video’s timeline. seek(seconds) takes a time on this shared timeline, from 0 through the video’s total duration. Use the supplied timestamps to align the visual changes with the reference video’s timeline. Task Recreate the visuals and all changes over time in the entire reference video using only HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Preserve the original aspect ratio, main content, composition, and timing. Visual implementation constraints All visual content must be generated using DOM/CSS, Canvas drawing commands, inline SVG, or procedural WebGL. This includes backgrounds, text, icons, illustrations, software interfaces, and controls. The reference video and extracted frames are for observation only and must not be used in the final rendering. Do not use video, full-frame or cropped screenshots, external images, AI-generated images, glyph atlases, extracted textures, or external fonts. Do not circumvent these restrictions by embedding reference imagery as Base64 data, pixel arrays, per-pixel drawing primitives, automatically traced shapes, or similar representations. Render text from actual strings using the browser’s text layout engine or Canvas fillText/strokeText. You may use fonts already installed on the system. Rebuild interfaces, controls, illustrations, and textures in code, preserving their main content, composition, and colors. Do not simply omit them or replace them with unrelated placeholders. Preserve the motion and transition timing of the reference video. Do not replace continuous motion with cuts between a few static images. Delivery requirements Return the entire implementation as the complete contents of a single index.html file, with no dependencies on other files or network resources. Expose window.videoCompare = { duration, width, height, seek(seconds) { /* Pause playback and render the requested time. */ } }, where duration is the supplied reference video’s actual total duration in seconds, and width and height match its supplied dimensions in pixels. seek(seconds) must pause the playback clock and reliably render the requested time, including when calls arrive out of chronological order or repeatedly target the same time. The deliverable must run in an isolated environment containing only index.html, without reading the reference video or supplied images. Output only the complete HTML document, starting with <!DOCTYPE html> and ending with </html>. Do not include Markdown code fences, explanations, or any text outside the HTML document.

blocks.en: C.3 Video Scoring Prompt
blocks.zh: C.3 视频扫描提示

blocks.en: Compare the generated video with the reference clip and rate how faithfully it reproduces the current focus on a scale from 0 to 5. Look through the complete generated video to find the corresponding content. When similar content appears more than once, use the surrounding states to identify the matching sequence. For static points, compare content, appearance, position, proportions, layout, spatial relationships, and information hierarchy. Check how long a state lasts when the focus requires it to persist. For dynamic points, compare starting states, intermediate changes, order, pacing, duration, coordination, and results. When the focus requires other areas to stay stable, compare their behavior too. Base the comparison on clearly visible frames and the details and relationships covered by the focus. The importance of a difference depends on what it changes, rather than how much screen space it occupies. Scores 5: The content, appearance, structure, key relationships, and progression covered by the focus are accurate and complete. Timing correspondence is correct, and no difference is discernible in the visible frames. 4: The main content, key relationships, and complete progression are accurate. The overall match is very close, with only isolated, very slight differences in position, proportion, or local timing. 3: Core content, structure, and key relationships are complete and correct. For dynamics, the required key states, steps, feedback, coordination, and results are reproduced, with essentially correct main order and pacing. Non-core details have clear local deviations, while the overall presentation remains close to the reference. 2: There are clear omissions, errors, or widespread deviations overall, but at least one substantive part directly relevant to the focus is complete and accurate. A static part includes specific content and correct structural relationships; a dynamic part includes the corresponding starting state, coherent changes, and correct result. 1: Some relevant content or motion is reproduced, with rough or scattered correspondence. It does not yet form a complete, accurate, substantive local structure, relationship, or action process. 0: The focus is not substantively reproduced. For a purely dynamic point, a static end state without the corresponding action scores 0. When the focus includes other requirements, score the parts actually reproduced. Timing and duration also affect the score. Appearing earlier or later as a whole, ending too early, or lasting too long all count as differences. An offset that preserves the main pacing and event relationships is minor; a clear change to a stage’s timeline placement, the main pacing, or synchronization limits the score to 2. Choose the highest score that matches the degree of reproduction achieved. Output Output only {"score": N}, where N is an integer from 0 to 5. Input {Input}
blocks.zh: 将生成的视频与参考片段进行比较,并评定它如何忠实地在0到5的尺度上复制当前焦点. 通过完整生成的视频查看找到相应的内容. 当类似内容不止一次出现时,使用周围的状态来识别匹配序列. 对于静态点,比较内容,外观,位置,比例,布局,空间关系,以及信息层次. 检查当焦点要求状态持续多久. 对于动态点,比较起始状态,中间变化,顺序,间距,持续时间,协调,以及结果. 当焦点需要其他地区保持稳定时,也要比较他们的行为. 比较的依据是清晰可见的框架以及重点所涉的细节和关系。 区别的重要性取决于它的变化,而不是它占据了多少屏幕空间. 分数5:焦点所覆盖的内容,外观,结构,关键关系,以及进度都是准确而完整的. 时间对应是正确的,在可见的帧中看不出任何区别. 4:主要内容,关键关系,完整进取是准确的. 整体比对非常接近,在位置,比例或本地时间上只有极小的孤立差异. 3:核心内容,结构和关键关系完整无误. 就动态而言,所要求的关键状态、步骤、反馈、协调和结果得到复制,主要顺序和速度基本正确。 非核心细节有明显的本地偏差,而总体列报方式仍然接近参考. 2: 总体上存在明显的遗漏,错误,或普遍偏差,但至少一个与重点直接相关的实质性部分是完整和准确的. 一个静态部分包括具体的内容和正确的结构关系;一个动态部分包括相应的起始状态,连贯的变化,以及正确的结果. 1:一些相关内容或动议被转载,带有粗略或分散的函证. 它尚未形成一个完整、准确、实质性的地方结构、关系或行动进程。 0:重点未实质复制. 对于一个纯粹的动态点,一个没有相应动作分数的静态结束状态 0. 当焦点包括其他要求时,得分实际复制的部分。 时间和持续时间也影响到得分. 以早期或晚期整体来看,结束得太早,或持续太长,所有这一切都算作差异. 保留主节奏和事件关系的抵消是微小的;对舞台时间定位,主节奏,或同步的明显改变,将分数限制在2. 选择与实现的复制程度相符的最高得分. 仅输出 {“分数 ” : N},其中N是一个整数从0到5。 输入 {输入}
